entries.5a0335a333bbc45f: In the fiscal year ended December 2025, revenue from external customers was ¥34,540 million for the Gift Solutions Business, ¥20,841 million for the Retail Business, ¥1,913 million for the Asset & Service Business and ¥241 million for the Trading Business, with the Gift Solutions Business accounting for a majority of consolidated revenue. By region, revenue was ¥57,277 million in Japan, ¥195 million in China and ¥63 million in other regions, with Japan accounting for most of the total. By product and service, revenue was ¥33,994 million from gift sales, ¥6,664 million from inbound, ¥12,941 million from apparel and ¥3,935 million from miscellaneous goods and other. There is no major customer accounting for 10% or more of revenue.
